enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up to chin. Turn fan dial to low. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Breathe deeply.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Pick up soap. Rub soap on hands. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off water heater. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out eggs. Close refrigerator. Place milk and eggs on counter. Open cupboard. Take out bowl. Close cupboard. Crack eggs into bowl. Pick up fork. Beat eggs. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour egg mixture into pan. Stir eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Slide eggs onto plate. Place plate on table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Pick up glass. Pour milk into glass. Drink milk. Pick up plate. Place plate in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse plate. Turn off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Close wardrobe. Place shirt on bed. Place pants on bed. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Open drawer. Take out socks. Close drawer. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up backpack. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place charger in backpack. Place notebook in backpack. Close backpack. Pick up phone. Place phone in pocket. Pick up keys. Place keys in pocket. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Read messages. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to office building. Open office door. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office on program coordination tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Open document. Type notes. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Hang up. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save spreadsheet. Walk to printer. Pick up printed documents. Walk back to desk. Staple documents. Place documents in folder. Open drawer. Place folder in drawer. Close drawer. Open browser. Search for information. Copy information. Paste into document. Save document.

Walk to break room. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out apple. Take out water bottle. Open water bottle. Drink water. Close water bottle. Pick up sandwich. Eat sandwich. Pick up apple. Eat apple. Pick up napkin. Wipe mouth. Place trash in bin. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office on afternoon tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Open project file. Review notes. Make phone calls. Speak on phone. Hang up. Type report. Print report. Walk to meeting room. Attend meeting. Take notes. Speak in meeting. Return to desk. Open email. Reply to email. Organize files. Update calendar. Save work. Shut down computer.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Read news. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Walk to bus door. Exit bus. Walk to home. Open front door. Walk inside. Close front door.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cupboard. Take out pot. Close cupboard. Turn on induction cooker. Place pot on cooker. Pour water into pot. Add vegetables. Add chicken. Stir. Cover pot. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up bowl. Pour soup into bowl. Place bowl on table. Pick up spoon. Eat soup. Pick up bowl. Place bowl in sink. Turn on tap. Rinse bowl. Turn off tap.

Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Press power button on TV. Press channel button. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put phone down. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Drink water. Place glass on table. Pick up remote. Turn off TV.

Sit at desk. Open laptop. Turn on computer. Open project file. Type code. Save file. Open browser. Search for reference. Read article. Copy text. Paste into document. Edit document. Save document. Open email. Send email. Close browser. Close project file. Shut down computer. Close laptop. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Read more. Put book down. Pick up computer. Open computer. Check email. Open document. Type notes. Save document. Close computer. Put computer on nightstand. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put phone down. Turn on desk lamp. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off water heater. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bed. Pull blanket. Lie down. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Turn to side. Adjust fan. Breathe slowly. Turn to back. Place arm under pillow. Pull blanket up. Turn to other side. Bend knees. Stretch. Remain still.
